text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Some time after the Revenge Stream in the forest... Having received an incentive for the succesful stream, Fubuki took {0} to a cafe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
密林でのリベンジ配信から、
しばらく後──
配信のインセンティブが入ったということで、
フブキは{0}をカフェへと連れ出していた。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Whoa, lol. That's an AMAZING amount of people♡ As you'd expect of a "refined cafè"♡ Onii-san, you should be grateful~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっわｗ　
人すっご♡
さっすが『映えカフェ』って感じぃ♡
お兄さん、
感謝してよね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Today's my treat, so♡ I have to reward my slave with more than just a whip sometimes, so this will do~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はぼくのおごりだから♡
ドレーには鞭だけじゃなくて、
たまにはアメもあげないとね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Besides, I've got those incentives  from streaming~ So I'm kind of rich right now~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにぼくぅ、
配信のインセンティブ入ってぇ～
プチ金持ちなんだよね～♡

text_block_list.name: Cafe Employee
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting~♡ Here's your "Midnight Guilty Romance ~A Duet of Lovers Where Love and Calories Dance~"♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待たせいたしました～♡
『真夜中のギルティ・ロマンス
～ラヴとカロリーが踊る恋人たちのデュエット～』
でございま～す♪

text_block_list.name: Cafe Employee
text_block_list.text: The top layer is chocolate cream, the middle layer is choco-ice, and the bottom layer is chocolate cake... This arrangement represents the obstacles of love that the two of you will have to overcome♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
上層にはチョコレートクリーム、
中層にはチョコアイス、
下層にはチョコレートケーキ……
これは、
お二人がこれから
乗り越える
愛の障壁を表現しております♡

text_block_list.name: Cafe Employee
text_block_list.text: Seating is time-limited, so please feel free to offer each other an "Ahhh♡" and enjoy this incredibly sweet challenge~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
座席は時間制ですので、
どうぞ積極的に
『あーん♡』
と差し出し合い、
甘すぎる試練をご堪能くださ～い♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: This is crazy~♡ Onii-san, look at this magnificence! I have to snap a pic for sure~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっば～～～♡
お兄さん
これは映えだよ！
トーコー用に撮らなきゃ～～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: We can definitely handle this much~♡ It's just me and you here~ ...Come on, let's eat it before it melts♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
これぐらいいけるっしょ～♡
こっちはぼくとザコお兄さんがいるしさぁ～
……ほら、
溶けちゃう前に食べよ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I-I can't take it anymore... Newb Big Bro... I'll let you handle the rest...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっぷ……
も、
もうムリぃ……
ザコお兄さん、
あとぜんぶあげる～……

text_block_list.name: Cafe Employee
text_block_list.text: Did you enjoy your dreamlike time♪ However... all dreams eventually end. Here is your receipt♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢のような時間をご堪能いただけましたか♪
しかし
夢とはいずれ覚めるものです……
こちらの伝票をどうぞ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Geh?! T-This price is not cute at all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
げっ！？
か、
かわいくない金額するじゃん……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm moderately wealthy, so this much is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ
ぼくはプチ金持ちだし、
これぐらい──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: IT'S GONE!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ないっ！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh?! No way?! M-My wallet... Don't tell me I actually lost it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？　
うそっ！？
ぼ、
ぼくのサイフ……
まさか落としちゃったとか！？

text_block_list.name: Cafe Employee
text_block_list.text: Hmmmmmm, this is a problem. Customers who try to dine and dash will be banned and immediately reported to the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～～～～～～
困りましたねぇ。
無銭飲食しちゃうようなお客様は、
出禁からの、
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】への即通報♡

text_block_list.name: Cafe Employee
text_block_list.text: Of course, the loaned device and account will also be confiscated~♡...
text_block_list.orig_text:
貸与中のデバイスもアカウントも
もちろん没収となっておりますが～～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ah, crap... I think I'm gonna pass out...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ヤバ……
ぼく、
意識飛びそうかも……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Oiii... Onii-san? Are you listening?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……お～い、
お兄さん？
聞いてる～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Geez~ Are you okay~? You're the one carrying the bags, so you need to be strong~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
もぉ～
大丈夫～？
荷物持ちなんだから、
しっかりしてよね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihihihi♡ But still~ Struggling with such a meager amount of bags~ You really are a wimp~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひっ♡　
にしてもぉ～
これぐらいの荷物で音をあげちゃうとかぁ～
ほんとモヤシだよね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: How hopeless~ I'll help you build up more stamina, Onii-san~ Eigh~
text_block_list.orig_text:
しょーがないなぁ～
お兄さんがもっと体力つくように、
ぼくも協力してあげる♡　
えいっ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: If we're lovers, we should at the very least cross arms♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱ恋人ならさぁ～
腕組みぐらいしないとね♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Geez, you're so mean. Did you forget? Onii-san... you're my BOY-FRI-END, now♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
んもぉ～
ひっどぉ～い。
忘れちゃったのぉ～？
お兄さんはぁ、
ぼくの
か・
れ・
ピ
じゃん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: So? Where are we going next♡? ...Huh!? That restaurant over there!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
で？　
次はどこ行くの～？♡
……えっ！？　
あそこのレストラン！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: That's the place I wanted to go to♡ Ah... so you made a reservation there because you recalled what I said?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくが行きたかったとこじゃぁ～ん♡
あ……
前に行きたいって言ったから、
予約してくれたワケ？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh? Hmm? You're trying so hard for me, just like a little puppy♡ Good boy, good boy♡ Mmm, you're such a good boy~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ～？　
ふぅ～～ん？
ぼくのためにがんばっちゃうとか、
ワンちゃんみた～い♡
えらいえらい♡　
ん～いい子でちゅね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Well then, since you waggled your tail so hard, guess I'll go along with it~♡ Ihihi~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
んじゃ、
ピがせっかく
がんばってくれたんだもん、
行ってあげますか～♡　
いひひっ♡

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After seeing off Fubuki, who was satisfied with their date, {0} returned home...
text_block_list.orig_text:
デートを堪能して満足した布武機を送り、
{0}が帰宅した直後──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ya-hoo~♡ You home yet, Newb Big Bro?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっほー、
ザコお兄さん帰った～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Since you loosened those purse strings soooo much for my sake today, I figured I'd give you a little reward~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は
ぼくのために、
お財布のひもを
ゆるっゆるにしてくれたお兄さんに、
ちょっとだけごほーびあげちゃおーと思って♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Onii-san~♡ Switch over to a video call for me~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇねぇお兄さん、
ビデオ通話に
切り替えてくれる～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah♡! How about it♡ Isn't it cute♡?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃーん♡
どーお♡　
かわいーでしょ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Aww? Why're you getting so flustered~♡ Don't tell me... you thought I wasn't wearing anything under this shirt~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれれ～？　
なんでそんなに焦ってんの♡
もしかしてぇ……
シャツの下、
ナニも着てないと思っちゃった～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Too bad for you♡ I'm wearing something underneath♡ And I chose it just for you, Newb Big Bro... a D-A-R-I-N-G swimsuit♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ざーんねんでしたぁ♡　
ちゃーんと着てるから♡
お兄さんのために選んだ、
ちょー大胆な、
み・
ず・
ぎ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Pffft♡ Your face is bright red, lol. Bet it'd be even better if you saw this in person~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ぷぷっ♡
お兄さんの顔真っ赤っかｗ
これ、
生で見たらヤバそ～だよね～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Oh dear...? Onii-san... don't tell me you can't hold back anymore... and your tail's wagging like crazy~♡?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれれ～？
お兄さんもしかして……
ガマンできなくてぇ、
尻尾ぶんぶんしちゃってるぅ～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: If you're looking forward to it that much... I could spoil you a little more~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなに期待してくれちゃってるならぁ、
もっとサービスしてあげてもいいけどぉ～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: But as your owner~♡ I guess it's my job to teach you a few things, huh~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもぉ、
ぼくはお兄さんの飼い主として、
イロイロ教えてあげないといけないっていうかぁ～？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: First, until next summer... "Stay"♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは、
来年の夏まで──
『待ーて』♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: If you're a good boy until then, I'll give you a very special reward~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ザコお兄さんがいい子にできてたら、
とびっきりのごほーびをあげる～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: So... make sure you book us another nice place for next summer too~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
──だからぁ……
来年の夏も
いいトコ……
予約しといてよね～♡

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Alright, good job well done~
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～い、
お疲れさまぁ～

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Hey~?
Are you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね～ぇ？
ちょっとあんた、
大丈夫ぅ？

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: What am I talking about, he asks... obviously that dream just now? As usual, I set up a scenario for you two, who never actually met in real life, to make it seem like you did...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ナニがって、
ホラ。
今の夢。
例によって、
現実で面識ないあんたたちを
あたしがそれっぽーくお膳立てしてあげたヤツなんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Or rather... shouldn't you be more aware of the danger near you? You were basically a perfectly trained puppy in that girl's head.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってか、
あんた
危機感持ったほーがいいんじゃない？
あの子の頭ン中じゃ、
あんた完全に
しつけられたワンちゃんだったわよ。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Even so... treating you like a puppy, huh? That little pink bitch, she's got some nerve... not only laying a finger on my toy, but actually making him shake hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
にしても……
あんたをワンちゃん扱いねぇ。
あのピンクのチビ、
あたしのオモチャに手ぇ出すどころか
お手させるとか
いい度胸してんじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Well, if I really put my mind to it... I could have you wrapped around my finger WAAAAY better than that little weasel ever could.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
あたしが本気出したら、
あんなイタチ娘より
ぜ～んぜん上手に
あんたのこと
転がせちゃうけどね～？

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: ...For example♡ You're the type who likes to be pushed around by girls, right? Ah, this isn't a quiz♡ I already know that much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
たとえばさぁ♡
あんたって、
オンナノコに振り回されるのが好きなタイプでしょ？♡
あ、
クイズじゃなくて。
あたしにはバレてっから♡

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Hopeless little newbs like you are easiest to handle when someone's nice to them every once in a while~♡ Of course, I know as much myself♡ ...You newb♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
そーゆー
どーしよーもない
ザコにはさぁ、
たまーに甘くしてあげるのが
一番効くのよね～♡
もち、
分かってて言ってんだけど♡　
……
ざぁ～こ♡

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Hey~ Little doggy♡ Shall your owner pet you♡ Your head? Or maybe... your T-U-M-M-Y? Which do you prefer?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ね～
ワンちゃん♡　
ご主人サマが
撫でてあげよっか♡
頭？　
それとも……
お・
な・
か？
どっちがい～い？

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Mm... Hey. Don't give me the silent treatment. Say something.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ちょっと。
ノリ悪いわねなんか言いなさいよ。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
W-Wha...! W-Who the hell would want to compete with a pipsqueak like her?
"Please forgive me, Onii-san!" Like hell I'd bawl my eyes out, grovel on the ground, and beg like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っっ！　
だ、
だ～れがあんなメスガキに対抗心なんざ持つかってのよ
あたしは何があっても
「ごめ゛ん゛な゛ざい゛お゛兄゛ざ～ん゛！」
とか
濁点まみれで泣き喚いてドゲザなんかしないんだからねっ！

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: In the first place... all of this 'cause she's wearing a swimsuit and her curves are showing a little? That pink little runt needs to stop getting so cocky. ...If I wore a swimsuit, you'd be squealing three times over.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だいたい
水着着たてーどで
ちょ～っと出るとこ出てるからって？
ちょーし乗るのもいい加減にしろってのよ
あのピンクチビ。
……あたしが水着着たら
あんたなんか、
３回回ってヒャンなんだから。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I had it playing the role of your "Master" already~ Well then, it's about time you finished your escape from reality and faced the loss of that wallet~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんっ、
もーご主人サマとかやめやめ～
んじゃ、
そろそろあんたたちの現実逃避を終わらせて、
サイフと向き合いなさいな──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Is this... the night pool? Why... was I having a weird dream...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
あり……？　
ここ、
ナイトプール？
ぼくなんで……
あれ、
変な夢みてた……？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ah...! T-That's right, the dine and dash! But I really lost my wallet!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
っ！
そ、
そうだ、
無銭飲食！
お財布ないんですけどぉ～～！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: C-Crap...! At this rate, they'll really report us to NIGHTMARE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やばっ……！
このままじゃマジで【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】に
通報されちゃうじゃ～ん！？

text_block_list.name: Izuna
text_block_list.text: Kyu kyuu!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゅきゅーっ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Could that really be...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
それってまさか！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: My wallet?! Izuna, did you find it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくのお財布～！？
イズナ、
見つけてきてくれたの～～！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Izunaaaaaa~!! You really are such a genius~♡ Good girl~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
イズナ～～～！！
やっぱイズナはてんさい♡
いいこいいこ～～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Now that my wallet's safely back, let's go swimming in the pool next♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
お財布も無事戻ってきたしぃ、
んじゃ、
次はプール泳ぎに行こ♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Actually... it looks like a new photo spot has opened up, and I need your help with something, Onii-san♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
実はぁ～
映えスポットが
新しくできたみたいでさぁ～？
お兄さんに手伝ってほしーことあるんだよねぇ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Don't worry♡ It's a simple "job" anyone can do♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
だいじょーぶ♡
誰でもできる、
簡単な『おシゴト』
だから♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Heheheh, so you already know♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひひｗ
わかってんじゃ～ん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: And so~ First, put on this special doggy headband and tail I made and let's go for a walk together♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってコトで──
ま
ずは、
このぼく特製のワンちゃんカチューシャと尻尾つけて、
一緒にお散歩してみよっか♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? You think you have a right to refuse after being treated to a meal? Here, it's decided~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～？
おごってもらった分際でキョヒケンがあるとでも～？
ハイ決定～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ah, you can run away if you want♡ I'll catch you right away, anyhow♡ Because you are... my slave♡ Hehehe♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
逃げてもいーよ♡　
どーせすぐ捕まえちゃうし♡
だってお兄さんは、
ぼくのドレーなんだから♡
いひひっ♡

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so, as Fubuki continued dragging him around at her own pace, another night passed for {0} at the resort.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうしてフブキに振り回されるまま、
{0}のリゾートでの夜は更けていくのだった。
